BUILT LINKED #receipts-pipeline as of 2026-10-01

Receipts is a TypeScript pipeline that reads a vendor's pages and independent sources (including SEC filings, NHTSA and IIHS), lets a model propose which claims contradict which, and discards any quote a deterministic gate cannot re-find in the fetched bytes.

Does not showThat a verbatim quote is a fair reading of its source, or that a proposed relation is real (see receipts-relation-check). The submission itself is not evidenced in the repo.
